newsitem.title: USA: Court rules El Paso Electric owes $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Court rules El Paso Electric owes $25 mln.

text.p: El Paso Electric Co said Friday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Western District of Texas, Austin Division, has found that the Central and South West Corp owes it $25 million in termination fees stemming from the failed merger of the two companies in 1993.

The company added that the court also ruled that CSW may also owe it an additional sum, referred to during the trial as the "interest carry." This amount and its award, if any, will be determined later. Both companies, said El Paso, have 20 days to advise the court on how they want to proceed on this issue.

El Paso, which emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in Feb 1996, also said that under the terms of the fourth amended plan of reorganization, $20 million of proceeds from the litigation with CSW will be distributed to its former common and preferred shareholders.
